policy.viridian: Keep Viridian City, Viridian Forest, Route 22 and Viridian Gym trainers unchanged; Giovanni himself uses cap 82.
policy.rematches: Active Vs. Seeker tiers use their map delta. Retired trainer definitions, including disabled League rematches, remain unchanged.
policy.static_encounters: Scripted wild battles use the area delta; gifts, eggs and trades are unchanged.
policy.future_gyms: Four new Gym milestones use bits 1-4 in the existing VAR_VIDRA_CRESTS, in story order. Their maps currently have no Gym battles or encounter tables to scale.
policy.minimum_level: Subtracting a stage delta never produces a level below 1; low-level fishing slots are floored at level 1.
